plain: To come together into one whole.

webster.text: To grow together; to unite, as separate bodies, or separate parts, into one body, as separate bones in an infant, or the fingers or toes.

example.quote: How far, then, will they coalesce together ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
